lines.en: Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true recently.
lines.cn: 最近，我梦想着找到失落的宝藏，这个梦想几乎成真了。

lines.en: A new machine called 'The Revealer' has been invented
lines.cn: 一种名为“The Revealer”的新机器已经被发明出来了。

lines.en: and it has been used to detect gold which has been buried in the ground.
lines.cn: 它已被用于探测埋藏在地下的黄金。

lines.en: The machine was used in a cave near the seashore where--it is said--pirates used to hide gold.
lines.cn: 这台机器被用于海边附近的一个洞穴中；据说，海盗们过去常常在那里藏匿黄金。

lines.en: The pirates would often bury gold in the cave and then fail to collect it.
lines.cn: 海盗们经常把黄金埋藏在洞穴里，但后来却没能把那些黄金取出来。

lines.en: Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.
lines.cn: 带着这台新机器，一支搜寻队进入了洞穴，希望能找到埋藏的宝藏。

lines.en: The leader of the party was examining the soil near the entrance to the cave when the machine showed that there was gold under the ground.
lines.cn: 当党的领导人正在检查洞穴入口附近的土壤时，机器显示地下有黄金。

lines.en: Very excited, the party dug a hole two feet deep.
lines.cn: 非常兴奋，大家一起挖了一个两英尺深的坑。

lines.en: They finally found a small gold coin which was almost worthless.
lines.cn: 他们终于找到了一枚小金币，但这枚金币几乎毫无价值。

lines.en: The party then searched the whole cave thoroughly but did not find anything except an empty tin trunk.
lines.cn: 随后，他们彻底搜查了整个洞穴，但除了一个空铁皮箱外什么也没找到。

lines.en: In spite of this, many people are confident that 'The Revealer' may reveal something of value fairly soon.
lines.cn: 尽管如此，许多人仍然相信，“揭示者”很快就会揭示出一些有价值的信息。
